title: Assistant Manager
description:
Own legal support for property acquisition, leasing and Design and Build transactions, from due diligence and negotiation through execution and operational support.

**Key Responsibility Areas**
============================

**1. Real estate agreements and negotiations.** Draft, review and negotiate LOIs, term sheets, lease deeds, leave and licence agreements, operating and revenue share agreements, CAM agreements, fit-out agreements, amendments, renewals and surrender deeds. Assess title, permitted use, rent, deposits, lock-in, termination, landlord obligations and liability risks.

**2. Property due diligence and registration.** Conduct and coordinate title and property due diligence, including ownership and authority, encumbrances, permitted use, OC/CC, fire NOCs and other approvals. Identify gaps, recommend safeguards, and coordinate stamping, execution and registration with internal teams and external advisers.

**3. Design and Build contracts.** Draft, review and negotiate client D&B agreements, renovation agreements, work orders and contractor, consultant, procurement and vendor contracts. Align scope, BOQ, price, payment milestones, variation approvals, timelines, handover, warranties, defects, delay remedies, indemnities and liability with approved commercials.

**4. Transaction and project support.** Work with Real Estate, Projects, Design, Operations, Finance and Procurement to close transactions within agreed TATs. Advise on landlord and project issues, variations, delays, claims and contractual disputes; coordinate notices and external counsel support where required.

**5. Client and miscellaneous contracts.** Support membership and managed-office agreements, client amendments, MOUs, NDAs, alliances, marketing and other commercial contracts as required. Review deviations and obtain approvals under the internal approval matrix.

**6. Centre compliance and general advisory.** Coordinate tracking and closure of applicable centre licences and permissions, including trade, FSSAI, Shops and Establishments, fire and safety and lift approvals. Research legal developments and provide practical advice on contractual, operational and other assigned legal matters.

**7. CLM and legal process improvement.** Manage assigned contract workflows on SpotDraft or the applicable CLM platform; maintain execution records, trackers, templates, clause libraries and playbooks. Monitor TATs and pending actions, improve SOPs and support business training and responsible legal automation.

**8. Privacy intellectual property and reporting.** Support privacy documentation, data processing terms and trademark portfolio matters, including filings, renewals, oppositions and counsel coordination. Maintain matter records and periodic reports; escalate material risks with clear recommendations.

**Core Skills**
===============

Strong contract drafting, negotiation and property due diligence skills; sound understanding of contract and property law, stamping and registration; ability to translate project commercials into contractual safeguards; stakeholder management, legal research, CLM proficiency and attention to detail.

title: Legal Officer / Legal Manager
description:
* **Job Title:** Legal Officer / Legal Manager – Manufacturing
* **Job Location:** SMA INDUSTRIAL ESTATE GT KARNAL ROAD JAHANGIRPURI
* **Experience Required:** 3 to 6 Years (strictly in a manufacturing or industrial setup)
* **Education:** LLB / LLM (Active registration with the Bar Council is mandatory)
* **Work Type:** Full-time, In-person

Key Responsibilities

* **Factory & Labour Compliance:** Ensure complete compliance with the **Factories Act**, Industrial Disputes Act, EPF, ESI, Payment of Bonus Act, and all other applicable labor laws and statutory government regulations.
* **Contract & Agreement Drafting:** Independently draft, vet, and review commercial agreements, vendor/supplier contracts, logistics/transportation agreements, dealer/distributor policies, and official legal notices.

* **Education:** Graduate degree in Law (**LLB / LLM**) from a recognized university. Must be registered as an advocate with the State Bar Council.

* **Field-driven** mindset with total comfort in visiting government offices, labor courts, and police departments.
* Exceptional **negotiation** and interpersonal skills to handle conflicts productively.
* Flawless **drafting capabilities** in both English and Hindi for contracts, letters, and court documentation.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹56,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Accounts & Tax Compliance Executive (Semi-Experienced)
description:
**Company:** Signitax Consultancy Services Private Limited  
**Location:** Delhi, India  
**Salary:** ₹12,000 per month  
**Experience:** 1–3 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Department:** Accounts, Taxation & Compliance

About the Company

Signitax Consultancy Services Private Limited provides accounting, taxation, business compliance and corporate support services to businesses and individuals. Our services include GST, Income Tax, TDS/TCS, ROC/MCA compliance, bookkeeping, accounting, payroll and business documentation.

Job Summary

We are looking for a semi-experienced Accounts & Tax Compliance Executive who can assist with routine accounting, GST compliance, income tax documentation, TDS work, ROC/MCA filings and client coordination.

The candidate should have practical knowledge of accounting and taxation, good Excel skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple client assignments while meeting deadlines.

Key Responsibilities

**1. GST Compliance**

* Assist with preparation and filing of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.
* Prepare sales and purchase data, GST workings and reconciliation statements.
* Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase registers and identify mismatches.
* Verify invoices, GSTINs, tax rates and input tax credit eligibility for review.
* Maintain GST return records and compliance trackers.

**2. Income Tax & TDS**

* Collect and organise documents for individual and business ITR preparation.
* Assist with computation workings and reconciliation of Form 26AS, AIS and TIS.
* Prepare TDS workings and assist with quarterly TDS return preparation.
* Track filing deadlines, challans, acknowledgements and outstanding documents.

**3. ROC/MCA Compliance**

* Assist with routine company and LLP compliance documentation.
* Maintain statutory records, master data, filing acknowledgements and compliance calendars.
* Collect financial statements, director details, DSC information and other documents required for filings.
* Assist with preparation of forms and attachments under supervision.

**4. Accounting & Bookkeeping**

* Perform basic accounting entries and ledger scrutiny in Tally or similar accounting software.
* Assist with bank, customer, vendor and ledger reconciliations.
* Prepare Excel workings, schedules and supporting documents.
* Maintain organised client-wise digital records.

**5. Client Coordination & Operations**

* Follow up with clients for pending documents, information and approvals.
* Update task trackers, due dates, filing status and pending-work reports.
* Assist with invoice preparation and payment follow-ups.
* Escalate missing information, discrepancies, notices and deadline risks promptly.

Required Skills

* Practical working knowledge of GST, TDS and basic income tax compliance.
* Basic understanding of ROC/MCA filings and statutory compliance.
* Working knowledge of Tally and Microsoft Excel.
* Good document management and data-entry accuracy.
* Ability to follow SOPs, manage deadlines and communicate professionally.
* Willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned tasks.

Eligibility

* B.Com, M.Com, or equivalent commerce qualification preferred.
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in an accounting or tax consultancy firm preferred.
* Candidates with practical GST and accounting experience will be given preference.
* Freshers without practical exposure to accounting and taxation are not preferred.

What We Expect

The candidate should be able to execute routine assignments with limited supervision after training, maintain accurate records, meet deadlines and communicate pending requirements proactively.

Complex tax matters, final compliance reviews and high-risk decisions will be handled by senior management.

**Interested candidates may apply with their updated resume, relevant experience and current notice period.**

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹12,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Manager/AVP – Operations
description:

title: Junior Legal Counsel (India & SEA Region)
description:
August Energy ("AE") is a developer and long\-term owner and operator of energy infrastructure assets, helping high\-quality industrial and commercial customers meet their decarbonisation goals, profitably, and at scale. We provide a comprehensive set of proven and customised energy\-as\-a\-service ("EaaS") solutions, including renewable energy, energy storage, cooling \& heating, heat recovery, compressed air and bioenergy. Headquartered in Singapore, with offices in India, Thailand, the Philippines and Vietnam ("Target Region"), we work with our customers across Southeast Asia and India.


Our Vision – Accelerating the essential transition to a sustainable energy future.


Our Mission – Creating a corporate decarbonisation leader by investing in and delivering cleaner energy infrastructure, today – profitably, efficiently and at scale.

  

**About the Role**


* August Energy is seeking a Junior Legal Counsel to join our growing legal team supporting Generation (Renewable Energy) and Integrated Utilities\-as\-a\-Service operations across India and Southeast Asia.


* Reporting to the Legal Counsel – India \& SEA, this role will provide day\-to\-day legal support across
* This is a hands\-on, execution\-focused role suited to an early\-career lawyer looking to build broad experience across the full project lifecycle — from development through financing, construction and operations — in a fast\-growing, cross\-border platform.


**Key Roles and Responsibilities**


**Contract Drafting and Negotiation**


* Draft and review routine commercial and project contracts — including NDAs, vendor and procurement agreements, land documents, and ancillary project agreements.


* Support negotiation of PPAs, EPC/O\&M and other project contracts, and assist with M\&A and financing due diligence, including data room management and diligence summaries.


**Project Development and Business Support**


* Provide day\-to\-day legal support to project teams during development and execution.


* Track and flag key contractual obligations, conditions precedent, and milestones across the assigned portfolio.


**Regulatory Compliance**


* Monitor regulatory developments in the energy and infrastructure sectors and prepare summaries for the wider legal team.


**Risk and Legal Advisory**


* Conduct legal research on jurisdiction\-specific issues and support the resolution of contentious matters.


* Assist in briefing and managing external counsel on routine and time\-bound matters.


**Policies and Sustainability**


* Support implementation of and adherence to August Energy's policies and procedures, including anti\-bribery and corruption (ABC), sanctions compliance, environmental and social governance (ESG) standards, and sustainability commitments.


**Regional Coordination**


* Work closely with the Legal Counsel – India \& SEA, and external counsel across jurisdictions; support cross\-border knowledge sharing and financing / investor relations workstreams as needed.


**Job Requirement**


1\. 2\-5 years' post\-qualification experience (PQE) in corporate and commercial law, ideally with some exposure to energy, infrastructure, or project transactions.


2\. Mix of law firm and/or in\-house experience preferred, with an aptitude for operating independently in a commercial environment.


3\. Qualified to practice law in India.


4\. Strong drafting and legal research skills in English, with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.


5\. Ability to manage multiple work streams and deadlines independently, while knowing when to escalate.


6\. Willingness to travel within the region as required.


**Preferred Experience**


1\. Direct or advisory exposure to renewable energy, EaaS, or broader infrastructure transactions.


2\. Familiarity with project finance documentation and processes.


3\. Working knowledge of a regional language relevant to the assigned market cluster is an advantage.


**Key Competencies and Attributes**


* Combines strong legal fundamentals with a commercial, solutions\-oriented mindset.


* Collaborates effectively across teams and takes ownership of assigned workstreams.


* Adapts quickly to dynamic, cross\-border environments with strong organisational and communication skills.


* Upholds the highest standards of integrity, ethics, and compliance.


What we Offer


* Opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing energy infrastructure platform at the forefront of Asia's energy transition.


* Hands\-on exposure across multiple jurisdictions and the full project lifecycle, with direct mentorship from senior regional counsel.


* Collaborative, mission\-driven culture focused on delivering meaningful environmental and commercial impact.


* Work with a diverse, experienced team backed by leading institutional investors.
